pages.text: $(li)$(item)RS Latch$(): L sets, R resets; front+left on when set, back+right on when reset (sides swappable, quiet mode in the GUI) $(li)$(item)Toggle$(): a pulse on L or R switches the output front <-> back; right-click toggles by hand $(li)$(item)Pulse Former$(): rising edge on B gives a 2-tick pulse
$(li)$(item)Randomizer$(): while B is on, front, left and right get random states every 4 ticks $(li)$(item)Synchronizer$(): waits for pulses on both L and R, then pulses; B resets
